notes_app_level: ★resolved a11y-targeting gotcha from earlier attempt: querying `see --a11y --pid <arc-pid>` returned empty UNTIL a click was made into the Arc window first to properly establish focus — this specific app needed an explicit focus-click before a11y-query worked, unlike Finder/Safari/Chrome which worked with just `open -a` + pid-query. worth applying to any app that returns empty a11y despite process running.

notes_no_open_item: ★browser-pattern: NO 'Open File'/'Recent Files' item in File menu at all(unlike document-editors) — browsers use tab/history-based navigation instead of file-open. this is expected/normal for this app-category, not a gap.
